tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides a game-theoretic attribution of how much each feature contributes to the prediction, directly indicating the impact of removing or masking a feature. Sensitivity analysis through feature ablation (masking) directly simulates the effect of setting the feature to zero, measuring the probability change in prediction outcome. Together, these tools offer both interpretability and empirical validation of masking effects on prediction stability.
